verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own overview lists "workflows" as a first-party platform capability, and a community note confirms Workflows is a real feature (an EE feature removed from Cal.diy). Nothing describes what these workflows do: email or SMS reminders, follow-ups, or triggers timed before or after a booking. The Zapier app and webhooks are external or developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of email/SMS reminder and follow-up sequences, before/after-booking timing and triggers, no-show reduction behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, automated reminder and follow-up sequences (email/SMS) fire around every booking to cut no-shows

citations.quote: with routing forms, workflows, payments, native video, and an app store of integrations
Cal.diy removes Teams, Organizations, Insights, Workflows, SSO/SAML and other EE-only features.
